website.note: Pipeline page (/pipeline) not present; clinical studies page covers diagnostic LDT clinical program only.

ctgov.note: All sponsor records on ClinicalTrials.gov are observational diagnostic-test studies for Galleri (multi-cancer early detection); none are interventional drug trials with Phase 1/2/3 designations.

commercial_product.name: Galleri
commercial_product.technology: Genome-wide cfDNA methylation sequencing with machine learning
commercial_product.regulatory_status: US laboratory developed test (LDT); PMA submission completed January 2026 (last module). Not yet FDA approved.
commercial_product.commercial_status: Commercially available in the US since mid-2021; ~475,000 commercial tests sold through Dec 31, 2025 (>185,000 in 2025).
key_studies: PATHFINDER 2 (interventional, ~35,000 participants, results presented ESMO Oct 2025)
NHS-Galleri Trial (randomized controlled, UK; topline announced 2025)

excluded_preclinical: Diagnostic Aid for Cancer (DAC) program - investment substantially decreased per Aug 2024 restructuring
Minimal Residual Disease (MRD) program - investment substantially decreased per Aug 2024 restructuring
no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: GRAIL is a commercial-stage diagnostics company focused on a single multi-cancer early detection (MCED) blood test (Galleri). It has no proprietary therapeutic drug candidates; clinical studies (PATHFINDER 2, NHS-Galleri, etc.) evaluate the diagnostic test, not drugs/devices on a P1/P2/P3 IND/IDE pathway. Beyond-Galleri programs (DAC, MRD) were de-prioritized in the Aug 2024 restructuring.
